Tracker.PenaltyHint: Wound penalty: existing wounds are subtracted from the 2d6 wound roll.
Tracker.SuppressedHint: Effects suppressed until the next short rest.
Tracker.Unpin: Unpin: back to the Perils tab

Roll.Title: {name} is wounded
Roll.PermanentTriggered: 2 or less: roll on the Permanent Wound table if the Constitution save fails.
Roll.PermanentSaved: Constitution save {total} vs DC {dc}: saved. No permanent wound.
Roll.NpcRerollLimit: Ten rerolls all gave a permanent wound: taking the best result left.
Roll.PermanentDirect: Permanent Wound! Rolling on the Permanent Wound table.

Hit.Title: {name}: armour and injuries
Hit.PsychicNoAblation: Critical hit, but psychic damage doesn't ablate armour.
Hit.ShieldStops: {shield} stops the effects of massive damage.
Hit.DeepWound: Deep Wound: {n} additional failed death saving throw(s).

Line.Immune: {why}: {name} is +3 armour and can't be ablated.
Line.Broken: The shield is broken and must be replaced.

Exempt.natural: Natural armour: AC is never ablated.
Exempt.unarmored: Unarmoured Defence: AC is never ablated.

Armour.ShieldNote: Shields can't be repaired and must be replaced.

MethodDesc.party: Needs {tools}. One piece per night without losing the short rest. Free.
MethodDesc.mending: The cantrip can fix pieces that have lost less than 3 AC.
MethodDesc.mendingNo: Lost 3 or more AC: beyond the capabilities of a cantrip.

Repair.Title: Armour repaired
Repair.craftsman: {name} repaired by a craftsman to AC {ac}.

ShieldBlock.Title: Shield Block
ShieldBlock.Prompt: {name} is about to take {amount} damage. Use your reaction to block with {shield}?
ShieldBlock.Hint: Blocking halves the damage to {half} and ablates the shield by 1 AC.
ShieldBlock.Refund: Last hit of {amount} halved: {refund} HP restored.
ShieldBlock.AlreadyTriggered: Wounds or exhaustion from that hit were already applied; the GM may undo them.

Treat.Title: {name}: treating wounds

Desc.kit: Medicine check in the field or during a short rest. Success removes the wound.
Desc.grit: During a quick rest. Always suppresses the wound until a short rest: 1 exhaustion on a success, 2 on a failure.
Desc.potion: A potion subdues one injury until a short rest.
Desc.longRest: Medicine check at a long rest. Success removes the wound.

Treat.Potion: A potion subdues {name} until a short rest.
Treat.Success: {method}: {who} passes the DC {dc} Medicine check. {name} is treated.
Treat.Fail: {method}: {who} fails the DC {dc} Medicine check. {name} remains.
Treat.GritSuccess: Grit and bear it: {who} passes the DC {dc} check. {name} is suppressed until a short rest; +{n} exhaustion.
Treat.GritFail: Grit and bear it: {who} fails the DC {dc} check. {name} is suppressed until a short rest; +{n} exhaustion.

Dialog.AddHint: * can be taken more than once. Immediate effects: Battered's exhaustion, Close Call's 1 HP and prone, Fatal Wound's death.
Dialog.Damage: Damage taken (sets the permanent-wound save DC)
Dialog.RemovePermanent: Permanent wounds are removed only by the regenerate spell (one per casting).
Dialog.PotionBody: A potion magically subdues one injury until a short rest.
Dialog.NpcPermanentBody: {name} rolled a Permanent Wound. Apply it only if this is a significant NPC; otherwise reroll.

Notify.AlreadyHas: {name} can't be taken more than once.
Notify.AlreadyResolved: That permanent wound has already been resolved.
Notify.PermanentNoTreat: Permanent wounds can't be treated; only regenerate removes them.
Notify.ShieldNoRepair: Shields can't be repaired; replace them.
Notify.MendingLimit: Lost 3 or more AC: beyond the capabilities of Mending.
Notify.GMOnly: Only the GM can do that.
Notify.SelectToken: Select a token or assign a character first.
Notify.NeedName: Give the custom wound a name.

ablation.Name: Ablated Armour
ablation.Hint: Critical hits and massive damage from attacks take 1 AC off the target's shield or armour. Natural armour, Unarmoured Defence and psychic damage are exempt.

npcFlatAblation.Name: Ablate stat-block AC
npcFlatAblation.Hint: NPCs with a flat AC and no armour items get a stacking -1 AC effect instead.

shieldMassive.Name: Shields vs massive damage
shieldMassive.Hint: What an equipped shield does against massive damage.
shieldMassive.Negate: Stops it: no wound roll, no ablation
shieldMassive.Absorb: Stops the wound roll; the shield loses 1 AC

shieldBlock.Name: Shield Block prompt
shieldBlock.Hint: Offer the Shield Block reaction before damage is applied (not with midi-qol; use the tracker button or macro).

shieldBlockNpc.Name: Shield Block for NPCs
shieldBlockNpc.Hint: Also prompt the GM for NPCs with shields.

shieldBlockTimeout.Name: Shield Block timeout (seconds)
shieldBlockTimeout.Hint: How long to wait for an answer before the damage goes through unblocked.

longRestDays.Name: Days per long rest
longRestDays.Hint: How many days of magic armour recovery a long rest counts as (the setting's long rest is 36 hours).

wounds.Name: Wounds and Injuries
wounds.Hint: Roll on the wound table when a character drops to 0 HP or takes more than half their maximum HP in one hit.

woundsNpc.Name: NPC wounds and injuries
woundsNpc.Hint: NPCs roll on the NPC Wounds & Injuries table when they take massive damage and survive (an NPC at 0 HP is simply dead or defeated). Wounds show as effects on the token and in chat.

countPermanent.Name: Permanent wounds count
countPermanent.Hint: Include permanent wounds in the number subtracted from the 2d6 roll.

exhaustionAtZero.Name: Exhaustion at 0 HP
exhaustionAtZero.Hint: Each time a character is reduced to 0 hit points they gain 1 level of exhaustion.

longRestTreatment.Name: Long rest Medicine checks
longRestTreatment.Hint: At a long rest, roll a DC 10 Medicine check for each temporary wound; successes remove it.

potionPrompt.Name: Potions subdue injuries
potionPrompt.Hint: When a wounded character drinks a potion, offer to subdue one injury until a short rest.

whisperGM.Name: Private chat cards
whisperGM.Hint: Whisper wound and armour cards to the GM and the character's owners.

npcPermanent.Name: NPC permanent wounds
npcPermanent.Hint: What happens when an NPC rolls a Permanent Wound (2 or less). The table says to reroll unless it is a significant NPC.

permanentSave.Name: Constitution save before a Permanent Wound
permanentSave.Hint: The rules text on the Wounds & Injuries table sends a roll of 2 or less straight to the Permanent Wound table. Turn this on to add a Constitution save (DC half the damage taken) first; a success avoids the wound.

tables.Name: Wound tables
tables.Label: Open or reset wound tables
tables.Hint: The three wound tables are ordinary roll tables in the world (in the "Shrimp's Homebrew Rules" folder). Edit them to change wounds, ranges or severity, or reset them to the defaults here.

overcharge.Name: Overcharging spells
overcharge.Hint: Master switch. Lets characters cast spells by spending Hit Dice (a checkbox in the spell's usage dialog). Turn off to remove Overcharging completely.

veteranLevels.Name: Veteran Levels
veteranLevels.Hint: Master switch. Levels beyond the level cap stop adding proficiency, hit points, spell slots and cantrip scaling, and their Hit Dice become Veteran Dice. Turn off to remove Veteran Levels completely.

atLevelCap.Name: At level cap
atLevelCap.Hint: GM toggle. Switch on when the party reaches the level cap: Veteran Levels apply (if enabled) and Overcharging uses the "at level cap" rules.

levelCap.Name: Level cap
levelCap.Hint: The level after which further levels are Veteran Levels.

Tables.MenuBody: Open a table to edit it: change a result's text, move its range, delete results to shorten the table, or add your own. Reset puts all three back to the campaign defaults.
Tables.ResetBody: Replace the results of all three wound tables with the defaults? Your changes to them will be lost.
Tables.ResetDone: Wound tables reset to the defaults.

Automation.Title: Wound automation (SHR)
Automation.Hint: What happens automatically when this wound is rolled. Wounds the module knows start with their usual effects; change them here. A result the module doesn't know only applies what you choose.
Automation.StatusesHint: Applied as long as the wound lasts.
Automation.EscalateHint: Added from the second time the same wound is gained.
Automation.SpeedHint: A second instance sets speed to 0.
Automation.CloseCallHint: At 0 HP, fall to 1 HP instead (and prone).

Veteran.Hint: Veteran Dice are spent first, only on short rest healing and Overcharging.

Overcharge.Title: Overcharge (SHR)
Overcharge.Use: Overcharge this spell (spend Hit Dice instead of a slot)
Overcharge.HintBase: Spend Hit Dice equal to the spell level, then make a spell check (DC 10 + level). On a failure the spell fails and you take that much Force damage.
Overcharge.HintCap: 1st-3rd level: spend Hit Dice equal to the level. 4th level and up: expend a lower slot and a Hit Die for each level below the spell.
Overcharge.CostSlot: Cost: a level {slot} slot and {hd} Hit Dice.
Overcharge.CostBase: Cost: {hd} Hit Dice, spell check DC {dc}.
Overcharge.NotEnoughWarn: Overcharging needs {hd} Hit Dice; you have {have}.

Invalid.level: Choose a level at or above the spell's level.
Invalid.noNeed: That slot is high enough to cast the spell normally.

Line.Fail: The spell fails. {damage} Force damage (HP now {hp}).
